employees.evidence: We expect our employees to have a strong working knowledge of the firm beyond their core responsibilities.

dei.evidence: Diversity strengthens us and delivers better results for our clients.

integrity.evidence: We say what we do and do what we say.

result.analyst_notes: Principle-led, assertive first-person plural voice. Clients come first, stated absolutely ('Their interests come first—always.'). Innovation and performance headlines dominate; employees, diversity and integrity appear briefly. No environment, safety or community commitments. Tone is aspirational, with competitive language and few hedges.
